title: Grandstream GWN7624 Dual Band PoE WiFi Access Point

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GWN7624 is a powerful in-wall dual-band Wi-Fi access point designed for hotels, offices, apartments, educational institutions, and commercial environments. It combines high-performance 802.11ac Wave-2 wireless connectivity with integrated Gigabit Ethernet ports and PoE support, making it ideal for professional network deployments.

The GWN7624 is an in-wall Wi-Fi access point that includes three Gigabit network ports, 2 which provide PoE, to provide internet connections and power for devices such as IP phones, computers, TVs and more.

Key Features


  • Dual-Band 802.11ac Wave-2 Wi-Fi Access Point
  • Up to 2.03Gbps aggregate wireless throughput
  • 5GHz 4×4:4 MU-MIMO technology
  • 2.4GHz 2×2:2 MIMO technology
  • Supports 200+ concurrent Wi-Fi clients
  • In-wall design for clean and professional installation
  • 1× Gigabit uplink port with PoE/PoE+ support
  • 3× Gigabit Ethernet ports for wired devices
  • 2× Gigabit ports with PoE PSE output
  • Advanced QoS for voice and real-time applications
  • Embedded controller for managing up to 30 local APs
  • Compatible with GWN.Cloud and GWN Manager platforms
  • WPA3 security with secure boot protection
